title: AI Transcription
description: This web app showcases an AI-powered speech-to-text workflow that accepts recorded or uploaded audio, transcribes it with modern ASR models, and lets users review and export polished transcripts.

title: Net Inspector
description: This diagnostic dashboard runs latency checks, port probes, and traceroutes to surface real-time network health insights with lightweight visual summaries for quick troubleshooting.

title: Random Password Generator
description: This web-based application is designed to generate cryptographically random passwords combining character sets, numbers, and symbols. Ensures high usability and entropy for personal security.

title: Daily To-Do Application
description: An intuitive, responsive task management application built to streamline daily workflows. Features persistent storage, quick filtering, and an accessible, keyboard-friendly interface.

title: Countdown & Stopwatch Timer
description: A precision time-tracking application combining dual-mode stopwatch and countdown timer functionality with millisecond accuracy and customizable alert triggers.

title: Simple Calculator
description: A streamlined arithmetic computing tool designed with keyboard listener shortcuts, operator precedence evaluation, and clean tactile feedback states.

title: Evergreen Impex
description: A multi-page corporate showcase website presenting enterprise import-export services, corporate portfolio assets, and an interactive contact inquiry pipeline.

title: Analog Clock
description: A canvas and CSS-driven analog clock displaying real-time hours, minutes, and continuous second sweeps using SVG trigonometry and CSS transitions.
